title: geissomeria distans

It has been found to possess several health benefits, including its potential to treat respiratory issues and its anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in reducing swelling and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
